exercises.instruction: REWRITE THE "HAVE" QUESTIONS AS "HAVE GOT" QUESTIONS

items.question: Does the kitchen have a microwave?
items.correct_answer: Has the kitchen got a microwave?

items.question: Does your house have a yard?
items.correct_answer: Has your house got a yard?

items.question: Do the Hendersons have a car?
items.correct_answer: Have the Hendersons got a car?

items.question: Do your parents have a computer?
items.correct_answer: Have your parents got a computer?

items.question: Do your neighbors have a basement?
items.correct_answer: Have your neighbors got a basement?

items.question: Does your cell phone have a camera?
items.correct_answer: Has your cell phone got a camera?

items.question: Does your town have a supermarket?
items.correct_answer: Has your town got a supermarket?

items.question: Do your children have a cat?
items.correct_answer: Have your children got a cat?

items.question: Does your husband have a camera?
items.correct_answer: Has your husband got a camera?

items.question: Does your school have a library?
items.correct_answer: Has your school got a library?

items.question: Does Jane have a cell phone?
items.correct_answer: Has Jane got a cell phone?

items.question: Do the kids have their bikes?
items.correct_answer: Have the kids got their bikes?
